newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower as commercials remain passive.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower as commercials remain passive.

text.p: A lack of aggressive commercial pricing allowed relatively small-lot sales to press CBOT rice futures to a lower close, traders said.
"There was a lack of commercial interest on the buy side but there also was a lack of farmer selling, which was offsetting," a trader said.
Traders said commercials were buying on a scale-down basis rather than chasing a rallying market.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 300 contracts, down from 484 Friday, according to the CBOT. Rice options volume was estimated at 50 contracts, down from 102 Friday.
Rice closed four to seven cents per cwt lower, with November down seven at $9.87 per cwt.
